newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-DATES FIXED FOR WORLD CUP DRESS REHEARSAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DATES FIXED FOR WORLD CUP DRESS REHEARSAL.

text.p: fixed the dates for the Tournament of France four-team World Cup
dress rehearsal in June next year.
France, hosts of the 1998 World Cup finals, world champions
Brazil, England and Italy are the participants.
The federation will officially present the tournament at a
Coaches Aime Jacquet of France, Brazil's Mario Zagallo,
England's Glenn Hoddle and Cesare Maldini, if he is appointed by
Italy as Arrigo Sacchi's successor, have been invited to the
June 3 - France v Brazil in Lyon
June 4 - Italy v England in Nantes
June 7 - France v England in Montpellier
June 8 - Italy v Brazil in Lyon
June 10 - England v Brazil in Lens
June 11 - France v Italy in Paris (Parc des Princes)
Kickoff times have not yet been decided.
